    if (speedMult > 0.01) {
      el.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01 * speedMult;
      el.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01 * speedMult;
      // Re-normalize
      const spd = Math.sqrt(el.vx * el.vx + el.vy * el.vy);
      if (spd > 0) {
        el.vx = (el.vx / spd) * el.baseSpeed;
        el.vy = (el.vy / spd) * el.baseSpeed;
      }
    }

    // Opacity: slightly reduced during stillness
    const opacityMult = 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.max(speedMult, 0.3);
    ctx.globalAlpha = el.opacity * opacityMult;
    ctx.fillStyle = FG;
    ctx.strokeStyle = FG;

    if (el.type === 'dot') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(el.x, el.y, el.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (el.type === 'line') {
      const dx = Math.cos(el.rotation) * el.length / 2;
      const dy = Math.sin(el.rotation) * el.length / 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(el.x - dx, el.y - dy);
      ctx.lineTo(el.x + dx, el.y + dy);
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      // mark — tiny rectangle
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(el.x, el.y);
      ctx.rotate(el.rotation);
      ctx.fillRect(-el.length / 2, -0.5, el.length, 1);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}

requestAnimationFrame(draw);
